title: 19000 - 19000/P2568/009576
models: Tüm VAG Grubu Modeller (Audi, VW, Seat, Skoda, Porsche)
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Incorrect/wrong ID from the G611-Radiator Identification Sensör Okuma Değerleri
Possible tapering or attempting to bypass the PremAir® system
stepByStepSolution:
Verify installation of G611-Radiator Identification Sensör Okuma Değerleri on radiator.
Sensör Okuma Değerleri can not be removed, doing so will cause intentional sensor damage.

technicalNotes:
The G611 communicates to the ECM via LIN-Bus, the sensor's unique ID (encrypted) and temperature.
There are no Measuring Value Block for this information.
